subject: Hosted API: Technical onboarding & session planning (SDK / streaming / tool-calling)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Singh <samir@carehaven.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted integration technical session — availability?

Hi Samir,

Thanks again for the time last week — excited to move toward a technical onboarding with your engineering team so we can surface an integration plan for Redwood's Hosted API (SDKs, streaming, function/tool-calling).

Quick ask: would your engineers be available for a 60–75 minute technical session where we cover:
- integration architecture and auth patterns (API keys, token exchange, optional SSO)
- SDK usage and streaming best-practices for low-latency clients
- function/tool-calling and structured outputs (example payloads + error handling)
- checklist items for Private/Dedicated considerations if regs come up

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue, Apr 12: 10:00–11:15 or 14:00–15:15
- Wed, Apr 13: 09:00–10:15 or 13:00–14:15

If none of those work, send a couple of slots and we’ll try to accommodate. I’ve cc'd Evelyn (solution lead) who will run the technical session.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: none
From: Samir Singh <samir@carehaven.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted integration technical session — availability?

Hi Marcus,

Thanks — that sounds perfect. I discussed with our platform and integration leads. We can do Tue, Apr 12 at 10:00 PT. A couple of quick asks before we lock:

1) Can you share a short agenda and any prep materials (auth scopes, sample SDK snippets) so our SRE can triage ahead of time?
2) We have two engineers who will attend: Priya Rao (integration lead) and Miguel Torres (platform). They may want to share a brief summary of current infra (K8s + Istio + Redis) during the call.

If you can send an invite with a Meet link, we’ll confirm on our side.

Best,
Samir Singh
Head of Platform Engineering | CareHaven
samir@carehaven.com

On Mon, Apr 5, 2027 at 9:03 AM Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai> wrote:

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted integration technical session — availability?

Monica / Jonas —

Samir confirmed Apr 12 at 10:00 PT for a 75-minute technical onboarding. Can you both attend? Key goals for the session:
- Walk through hosted API auth patterns and token lifecycle (our recommended short-lived keys + rotation).
- Live SDK demo (Python + Node), focusing on streaming integrations and reconnect behavior.
- Show function/tool-calling examples (structured JSON outputs + error/fallback logic).
- Run a short Q&A about observability (per-route latency, cost breakdown) and the integration checklist.

Jonas: can you bring the streaming sample and the recommended client-side backoff logic?
Monica: can you prepare the brief checklist doc (integration readiness) and the integration prep spreadsheet? I’ll assemble the initial agenda and send attachments.

Also — we should confirm whether CareHaven needs us to cover Private/Dedicated options in the same call; if so we should leave 15 minutes at the end for capacity/region/SLA implications.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.ai

Attachment: none
From: Samir Singh <samir@carehaven.com>

Cc: Priya Rao <priya@carehaven.com>, Miguel Torres <miguel@carehaven.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted integration technical session — availability?

Evelyn / Marcus,

Apr 12 at 10:00 PT works for us — confirmed. Please include Priya and Miguel on the invite. Two notes for the agenda:

- Could you add a short segment (10–15 min) on SSO/KMS integrations and data segmentation options? We have compliance folks who want a quick overview.
- Also, please attach your integration checklist and any sample snippets for streaming reconnect logic so our SREs can review beforehand.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Samir
